dedupe_keys.name: micro water harvesting intervention impacts on soil moisture in rangelands jordan 2017 2018

description: MELDATA publishes soil-moisture observations along a hillslope in Jordanian rangelands to assess micro-water-harvesting interventions. The provider describes time-domain reflectometry measurements at depth increments of 0–20, 20–40, 40–60 and 60–80 cm. The description covers December 2017 to September 2018; the structured coverage fields give 19 December 2017 to 25 September 2018. The observations describe the spatial and temporal response to the interventions and provide calibration or comparison data for simulations of their soil-water behaviour. The directory lists a soil-moisture CSV and three data dictionaries. This release is distinct from the 2016/2017 Al-Majeddyeh records and from an inventory of intervention sites. Exact location, sampling frequency and treatment definitions remain unverified. Access: the native repository lists public files and free access under CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: no dataset files were downloaded; actual contents, completeness and numerical quality were not checked. Related resources are linked through the MELDATA parent collection.
